# Reverse Engineering Assisted by AI — Mapping Legacy Truth

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta-engenharia-reversa>. Author: **Mauricio Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-05-01 · Updated: 2026-06-21.

## In short

Before modernizing (To-Be), it is necessary **freeze a high-fidelity photo of what the system really does today (As-Is)**. Critical knowledge usually lives hidden — in Apex, fragmented Flows and in the head of a few. Modernizing without mapping is erasing vital rules without knowing.

- **Discovery guided by journeys** — starts from a business journey and follows the execution trail, isolating the dead code.
- **Evidence Matrix** — crosses structural, state, operational and human inputs to avoid false positives.
- **Behavior Inventory** — core rules, side effects and workarounds, classified by trust.
- **As-Is → contracts** — the audited inventory becomes the raw material of validation schemas.

## From the past to the future

The purpose of AI assisted reverse engineering is not to generate eternal living documentation — it is to freeze As-Is faithfully enough for architects to decide, auditably, what to preserve, redesign or discontinue. Each catalogued rule then becomes a clause in validation schemas.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is AI assisted reverse engineering?**

It is the use of AI to reveal and freeze, with high fidelity, the actual behavior of a legacy system (the As-Is) before modernizing it. The goal is not to generate eternal documentation, but an auditable inventory for architects to decide what to preserve, redesign or discontinue.

**Why freeze the As-Is before modernizing?**

Because every legacy system suffers from "tribal knowledge": rules that sustain business but that nobody wrote. Modernizing without mapping erases vital rules without knowing — High fidelity As-Is is the security network of transformation.

**What's the best discovery strategy?**

The discovery guided by critical journeys and risk (top-down with deep dive): starts from a business journey, follows the execution trail (call stack) and maps every component it touches. This quickly isolates the dead code, which belongs to no journey.

**What is the Evidence Matrix?**

It is a multifaceted pool that prevents false positives: structural inputs (metadata, Apex, Flows), state (Custom Metadata/Settings), operational (Event Monitoring, Debug Logs, which reveal zombie code) and human (commits, tickets, interviews, which give the why of the rule).

**What is the Behavioral Inventory?**

It is the final asset of mapping: not a catalogue of IFs/ELSEs, but core rules, side effects and historical workarounds, each classified by the trust of evidence. He is the raw material of the validation contracts of the next phase.

## Glossary

- **As-Is** — High-fidelity photography of what the system actually does today, before modernizing.
- **Evidence Matrix** — Multifaceted Pool (structural, state, operational, human) that avoids false positives in discovery.
- **Behavior Inventory** — Core rules, side effects and As-Is workarounds, classified by evidence trust.
- **Tribal knowledge** — Rules that sustain business but no one has documented; they live in the minds of few.
